text: Every visit we book changes how far our doctors drive. Get Best Route finds the time that fits the day best, so doctors drive less and see more families.
Tom Chen calls. Biscuit needs his ear rechecked. Click plus Appointment.
The one thing to remember: let routing pick the doctor and time, then read the arrival window to the family.
It searches from today through the next week. Change the dates if the family wants later.
The doctor comes from the calendar you were on. Type another name to change it, or tick A-SAP to search every doctor in the zone.
Then the visit type. It sets how long the visit takes.
Find the family.
Tom Chen.
Pick the pet. If you skip this, the visit books with no pet.
Scout checks the address and finds the zone.
Click Get Best Route.
The best fit is first. It shows the arrival window, how much driving it adds, and how much of the day is left open.
View Placement shows it on the doctor's calendar.
Here's where Biscuit would go, and the arrival window.
If you need to check with the family, call or text them from here.
Click Book.
Each pet gets its own visit at this time, with its own type.
Add why they're coming.
Then Book appointment.
It's on the calendar. Now read Tom the arrival window.

The most common mistakes: skipping the pet, which books a visit with no patient, and telling the family the start time instead of the arrival window. Remember: let routing pick the doctor and time, then read the arrival window to the family.
